create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with modules, environment, and params to manage symbolic regression training
run_enc_dec_step: run an encoding/decoding training step for a given task using the Trainer enc_dec_step method
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optional optimizer state using the Trainer save_checkpoint method
reload_checkpoint: reload a saved checkpoint to resume training from a previous epoch using the Trainer reload_checkpoint method
optimize_loss: optimize the model by computing gradients and updating parameters using the Trainer optimize method
